Frederikssund is a Danish municipality tracked in the national clinical quality registries for atrial fibrillation treatment. In the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), Frederikssund is one of 98 municipalities analyzed to support local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

Specifically, the municipality's data concerning stroke (apoplexy) events among atrial fibrillation patients is utilized in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5 [^src1]. This indicator evaluates the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulation (AK) therapy [^src1]. Frederikssund's specific performance metrics for this indicator are detailed in a tabular format on page 93 of the report, which lists patient denominators, event counts, and calculated rates alongside confidence intervals [^src1]. 

The available evidence for Frederikssund is limited to this single tabular mention regarding its Indicator 5 metrics. No further historical, relational, or claim-based details are recorded in the provided corpus.
